matched_articles.title: Samsung Electronics names new heads of memory chip, mobile businesses
matched_articles.summary: Samsung Electronics 관련 기사다. 기사 제목은 'Samsung Electronics names new heads of memory chip, mobile businesses'이다. Hwang Sang-joon was promoted to president and will become the head of the memory business, and President Choi Won-joon was named the head of the mobile device business, Samsung said in a statement. Samsung Electronics said on Friday that it appointed new heads of its memory chip and mobile device businesses Hwang Sang-joon was promoted to president and will become the head of the memory business, and President Choi Won-joon was named the head of the mobile device business , Samsung said in a statement "He is expected to continue help strengthen the competitiveness of memory products in the AI era ," Samsung said in its statement Samsung Electronics Co-CEO and Vice Chairman Jun Young-hyun will continue to oversee the broader device solutions division, which includes memory and logic chips Co-CEO and President TM Roh will remain as the head of the device experience division, which includes mobile devices, televisions and home appliances, Samsung said. 이 기사는 해당 기업과 연결된 해외 보도를 바탕으로 정리했다.
